gnpa_ratio.label: Gross NPA
gnpa_ratio.definition: Gross non-performing advances divided by gross advances at the same date; includes global standalone operations.

net_npa_ratio.label: Net NPA
net_npa_ratio.definition: Net non-performing advances divided by reported net advances at date. Eligible regulatory deductions can differ from balance-sheet net advances; reconciliation to reported ratio is required.

cost_income_ratio.label: Cost / income
cost_income_ratio.definition: Annual operating expenses / (net interest income + other income); provisions and taxes excluded.

casa_ratio.label: Global CASA
casa_ratio.definition: Closing global current and savings deposits / closing global deposits. Do not substitute domestic CASA.

nim.label: Net interest margin
nim.definition: Annual NII / average interest-earning assets. Quarterly values require annualization and consistent average asset basis.

roa.label: Return on assets
roa.definition: Annual PAT / average assets; reported ratios retained, not rebuilt from closing assets.

roe.label: Return on equity
roe.definition: Annual attributable earnings / average ordinary equity; equivalent shareholder perimeter required.

credit_cost.label: Credit cost
credit_cost.definition: Issuer reported annual credit-cost ratio; provision scope and averaging require verification before reconstruction.

slippage_ratio.label: Slippages
slippage_ratio.definition: Issuer reported annual ratio; do not confuse fresh slippages with all NPA additions.

pcr_including_two_ratio.label: Provision coverage incl. technical write-offs
pcr_including_two_ratio.definition: Issuer PCR including technical write-offs; distinct from on-balance-sheet provisions/GNPA.

cost_of_deposits.label: Cost of deposits
cost_of_deposits.definition: Annual deposit interest expense / average deposits; this is not full cost of funds.

cost_of_funds.label: Cost of funds
cost_of_funds.definition: Interest cost / consistent average interest-bearing funding including borrowing; unavailable.

capital_ratio.label: Basel III capital
capital_ratio.definition: Regulatory capital / risk-weighted assets. Neither simple ratio averaging nor ordinary equity/total assets is valid.

eps_basic.label: Basic EPS
eps_basic.definition: Attributable annual earnings / weighted-average ordinary shares; merger swap and capital issuance prevent direct historical aggregation.

book_value_per_share.label: Book value / share
book_value_per_share.definition: Consistent ordinary book equity / actual ending shares; do not mix share application money or revaluation conventions.

rules: Ratios are reconstructed from underlying aligned amounts; never average reported ratios.
Genuine requires at least four post-merger quarters, ended transition relief, comparable definitions, a robust peer result outside uncertainty, persistence, and independent operational evidence.

Only after those evidence gates: Genuine if more than half the positive headline change survives; Mixed if a smaller positive portion survives; Optical if the adjusted signal lies within uncertainty; Masked deterioration if the headline improves while the adjusted signal deteriorates outside uncertainty.
Otherwise Too early to tell means insufficient evidence, including historical cases with incomplete data. An unexplained residual alone never establishes a Genuine verdict.
Unknown accounting and one-off effects stay unquantified inside the residual. The bridge reconciles arithmetic, not causal identification.
No overall Genuine finding unless every material domain is supported and passes the gates. Missing domains keep the overall finding Too early to tell.
